title: Validate JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model against OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change
summary: OpenClaw 2026.3.11 removed agent-send from isolated cron jobs. JOB-CI-001 execution profile may be affected. Needs validation and profile update if broken.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) flagged that JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model may be affected by OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change: isolated cron jobs can no longer perform ad-hoc agent sends. Validation required: check if JOB-CI-001 uses isolated-cron agent-sends; if yes, update delivery model and run smoke test; update cron post-update smoke checklist.
proposed_action: Validate and update JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model for 2026.3.11 compliance
